releases.notes:
## Venti Client 1.1.0

Download the jar for your Minecraft version and put it in your `mods` folder together with Fabric API.

| Minecraft | File |
| --- | --- |
| 26.2 | `venti-1.1.0+mc26.2.jar` (needs Java 25 and the OpenGL graphics setting) |
| 1.21.11 | `venti-1.1.0+mc1.21.11.jar` |

Older versions (1.21.6 to 1.21.10) are discontinued; their final builds are in the releases marked **(DISCONTINUED)**.

### What's new
- **Minecraft 26.2 support**
- **Emojis**: type `:sob:`, `:skull:`, `:fire:` and about 250 more in chat
- **FPS Counter** on the same card style as the Spotify HUD
- Foldable Menu Color in the Panels menu
- New module names: Avatar, Viewmodel, Viewmodel Arm, Hand Glow, Swing Speed, Aurora Sky, Orbit Orbs, Effect Particles, Totem Ghost, Copy Coords, Stream Hider (your settings carry over)
- Fixed a rare crash while building the menu fonts
- A full guide in the [wiki](https://github.com/Venti-Client/VentiClient/blob/main/docs/WIKI.md)

Open the menu with Right Shift.

releases.notes:
Final build of Venti Client for **Minecraft 1.21.10**.

This version is **discontinued** and will not get new features or fixes. For the latest version, use Minecraft 1.21.11 or 26.2 with [Venti Client 1.1.0](https://github.com/Venti-Client/VentiClient/releases/latest).

Requires Fabric Loader and Fabric API. Open the menu with Right Shift.
